dataset: PlantSeg v2, Zenodo 13958858, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, md5 16cb69a5d97a61bc553a572f929490bf; research evaluation only; images not redistributed
queries: PlantSeg images of STRICT-tier mapped classes (11 SegPPD classes) that survive the leakage screen (hash rule pHash<=12 & dHash<=18, OR frozen DINOv2-B CLS cosine >= 0.85 to any of the 2,263 SegPPD images)
gallery: SegPPD Protocol B gallery_B (809 images, all 75 classes; retrieval is open over all 75 classes, not restricted to the 11 mapped ones)
models: D5ck_* = DINOv2-B last-4 blocks + SupCon, seeds 0/1/2, retrained with checkpoints (same config as the declared headline); R1-style ResNet50 and frozen baselines for context
preprocessing: PlantSeg image -> EXIF transpose -> RGB -> bicubic squash to 256x256 -> bicubic to 224x224 -> ImageNet norm; embedding = mean of image and h-flip, L2-normalised; exact squared-L2 ranking
headline: mean over the 3 seeds of Hit@1 (macro over the 11 mapped classes); 95% CI by bootstrap over classes AND over images within class (reported both)
secondary: loose-tier classes (4) reported separately, never in headline; per-class Hit@1; P@10
no_selection: no model, threshold or mapping may be changed after the external result is seen
known_limits: undetected overlap (heavier crops/edits) cannot be excluded
11 of 75 classes only, no healthy classes
PlantSeg images are original-resolution web photos squashed to 256x256 (SegPPD provenance of resizing unknown)
screen threshold 0.85 chosen by visual review of SegPPD-vs-PlantSeg pairs
